svg.title: Example of resources in a cloud
svg.desc: A folder belongs to the cloud and contains two isolated cloud networks. In network 1, a web server virtual machine is connected to subnet A, 10.0.1.0/24, in availability zone A, and a MySQL cluster host is connected to subnet D, 10.0.2.0/24, in availability zone D. In network 2, a test virtual machine is connected to subnet A, 10.0.2.0/24, in availability zone A. Address ranges overlap only between different networks.
